title: A Model of Macroeconomic Policies with Endogenously Insurable Exchange Rates
title_zh: 内生可保汇率下的宏观经济政策模型
title_primary: 内生可保汇率下的宏观经济政策模型
title_secondary: A Model of Macroeconomic Policies with Endogenously Insurable Exchange Rates
authors: Mr. Suman S Basu & Pablo Winant
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a tractable small-open-economy model in which uncovered interest parity premia on foreign exchange (FX) markets arise from the endogenous lack of insurability of exchange rate risks. Asymmetric information about monetary policy can make the tails of the exchange rate distribution uninsurable in FX hedging markets, which in turn generates premia in FX spot markets because of the risk aversion of lenders holding the external debt. There is a role for government intervention because of an information sensitivity externality: agents do not internalize that their actions can reduce the insurability of exchange rates. The model predicts that premia may be amplified by weaknesses in monetary, fiscal, and financial policy frameworks, and can be reduced through reforms which reduce the sensitivity of exchange rates to private information. The constrained efficient policy depends on the composition of external lenders and may include delegation of monetary policy to an “aloof central banker”, constraints on fiscal policy, more active use of macroprudential tools, and institutions which limit asymmetric information.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个易于处理的小型开放经济模型，在该模型中，外汇市场上未覆盖利率平价溢价源于汇率风险内生性的不可保险性。货币政策信息不对称可能导致汇率分布的尾部在外汇对冲市场中无法保险，进而因持有外部债务的贷款人风险厌恶而在外汇即期市场产生溢价。政府干预存在必要性，源于信息敏感性外部性：个体未内化其行为可能降低汇率的可保险性。模型预测，溢价可能因货币、财政及金融政策框架的薄弱而被放大，而通过改革减少汇率对私人信息的敏感性则可降低溢价。约束有效政策取决于外部贷款人的构成，可能包括将货币政策委托给“超然央行行长”、对财政政策施加约束、更积极地运用宏观审慎工具，以及设立限制信息不对称的制度。

title: Inequality along the European Green Transition
title_zh: 欧洲绿色转型中的不平等问题
title_primary: 欧洲绿色转型中的不平等问题
title_secondary: Inequality along the European Green Transition
authors: Guido Ascari, Andrea Colciago, Timo Haber, Stefan Wöhrmüller
official: 官方在线 2025-03-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The EU aims for 42.5% green energy consumption by 2030. What are the effects of the European green transition on inequality? We answer this question using a heterogeneous-agent model with non-homothetic preferences for energy and non-energy goods, calibrated to European data. We study the impact of an increase in carbon taxes designed to meet the EU target under different revenue-recycling strategies. Redistributing tax revenues via uniform transfers reduces consumption inequality, shifts the welfare burden to high-income households, but leads to significant output losses. Subsidizing green energy producers boosts energy production, reduces output losses, and requires a smaller carbon tax to meet the EU target. However, it increases consumption and income inequality, with the highest welfare costs borne by low income and asset-poor households. Our findings highlight key trade-offs between equity and efficiency in green transition policies.
abstract_zh: 欧盟设定了到2030年实现42.5%绿色能源消费的目标。欧洲绿色转型对不平等有何影响？我们通过构建一个包含能源与非能源商品非位似偏好的异质性主体模型，并依据欧洲数据进行校准来回答这一问题。我们研究了为实现欧盟目标而设计的碳税增加在不同税收返还策略下的影响。通过统一转移支付重新分配税收收入，可以减少消费不平等，将福利负担转移至高收入家庭，但会导致显著的产出损失。补贴绿色能源生产者则能促进能源生产，减少产出损失，并且实现欧盟目标所需的碳税较低。然而，这种做法加剧了消费和收入不平等，低收入及资产匮乏家庭承担了最高的福利成本。我们的研究结果凸显了绿色转型政策中公平与效率之间的关键权衡。

title: Affordable Housing, Unaffordable Credit? Concentration and High-Cost Lending for Manufactured Homes
title_zh: 经济适用房，难以负担的信贷？活动房屋的集中度与高成本贷款
title_primary: 经济适用房，难以负担的信贷？活动房屋的集中度与高成本贷款
title_secondary: Affordable Housing, Unaffordable Credit? Concentration and High-Cost Lending for Manufactured Homes
authors: Sebastian Doerr, Andreas Fuster, John Y Campbell, Tarun Ramadorai, Arna Olafsson 等
official: 官方在线 2025-03-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows that high market concentration in the multi-billion-dollar manufactured home loan market allows lenders to charge significantly higher interest rates than for site-built homes. Loan-level data indicate that borrowers in counties with higher lender concentration face significantly higher rates. Evidence from bunching at the regulatory HOEPA rate threshold, an instrumental variable analysis, and a difference-in-differences analysis around HOEPA's introduction suggests a causal link. We further show that integrated lenders, which play an outsized role in the manufactured home loan market, charge particularly high rates, and we provide evidence suggesting that these lenders exploit their market power over borrowers.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，在数十亿美元的预制房屋贷款市场中，高市场集中度使得贷款机构能够收取显著高于现场建造房屋的利率。贷款层面的数据显示，在贷款机构集中度较高的县，借款人面临显著更高的利率。围绕监管性HOEPA利率阈值的聚集现象、工具变量分析以及HOEPA引入前后的双重差分分析所提供的证据，均表明存在因果关系。我们进一步指出，在预制房屋贷款市场中占据主导地位的综合贷款机构收取的利率尤其高，并提供证据表明这些贷款机构利用其对借款人的市场支配力。

title: Multibrand Price Dispersion
title_zh: 多品牌价格离散
title_primary: 多品牌价格离散
title_secondary: Multibrand Price Dispersion
authors: Mark Armstrong, John Vickers
official: 官方在线 2025-12-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study a market in which firms each might supply a number of variants, or "brands", of fundamentally the same product. Consumers differ in the sets of brands they consider, and firms compete using (multi-dimensional) mixed pricing strategies. We show when firms apply uniform pricing across their brands, and when they use segmented pricing so that one "discount" brand is priced below another "premium" brand. We study the case of symmetric brands in particular, and discuss the impact of a firm introducing a new brand, of imposing a requirement to set uniform prices across brands, and of mergers between firms.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个市场，其中每家企业可能供应同一基础产品的多个变体或“品牌”。消费者在考虑的品牌集合上存在差异，而企业则采用（多维）混合定价策略进行竞争。我们展示了企业何时对其各品牌实施统一定价，以及何时采用细分定价，使得一个“折扣”品牌的价格低于另一个“高端”品牌。我们特别研究了对称品牌的情形，并讨论了企业引入新品牌、强制要求跨品牌统一定价以及企业间合并的影响。

title: Closing the gap in borrowing costs for emerging market firms
title_zh: 缩小新兴市场企业借贷成本差距
title_primary: 缩小新兴市场企业借贷成本差距
title_secondary: Closing the gap in borrowing costs for emerging market firms
authors: Paolo Mauro, Césaire A. Meh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Firms in low- and middle-income countries persistently pay more to borrow than firms in high-income economies. Drawing on a new World Bank Group study of more than 330,000 bond issues, this column shows how stronger sovereign benchmarks, deeper domestic institutional investor bases, and carefully sequenced financial liberalisation can broaden market access and lower borrowing costs for firms in these countries.
abstract_zh: 中低收入国家的企业借款成本持续高于高收入经济体。基于世界银行集团一项涵盖超过33万笔债券发行的新研究，本专栏指出，强化主权基准、深化国内机构投资者基础以及审慎有序的金融自由化，能够拓宽这些国家企业的市场准入并降低其借贷成本。

title: Consequences of Growing Up Displaced: Evidence from Displaced Children in Colombia
title_zh: 流离失所成长的后果：来自哥伦比亚流离失所儿童的证据
title_primary: 流离失所成长的后果：来自哥伦比亚流离失所儿童的证据
title_secondary: Consequences of Growing Up Displaced: Evidence from Displaced Children in Colombia
authors: Hiller, Tatiana, Moya, Andrés, Rozo, Sandra V.
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how forced displacement shapes child development beyond socioeconomic disadvantage. The paper uses original data on roughly 1,600 Venezuelan refugees, Colombian internally displaced individuals, and nondisplaced children in Medellín, Colombia. The analysis adapts rank-rank regressions from the intergenerational mobility literature to a forced displacement setting, ranking each child’s developmental outcomes against household wealth. The paper documents substantial gaps that persist after holding wealth and parental background fixed. It also shows that the cause of displacement shapes the nature of the gaps. Venezuelan refugees displaced by acute material deprivation fall 19 and 13 rank points behind in cognitive and physical development, respectively. Colombian children displaced by armed conflict fall 12 rank points behind in depression and exhibit elevated trauma. Access to regularization and social services is associated with narrower gaps.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了被迫流离失所如何超越社会经济劣势影响儿童发展。研究基于哥伦比亚麦德林约1600名委内瑞拉难民、哥伦比亚国内流离失所者及非流离失所儿童的一手数据。分析将代际流动性文献中的排名-排名回归方法适配至被迫流离失所情境，依据家庭财富对每位儿童的发展成果进行排序。研究发现，在控制财富与父母背景后，发展差距依然显著存在。同时，流离失所的成因决定了差距的性质：因严重物质匮乏而流离失所的委内瑞拉难民儿童，其认知与身体发展分别落后19个和13个排名位次；因武装冲突而流离失所的哥伦比亚儿童，其抑郁指标落后12个排名位次，并表现出更高的创伤水平。获得合法身份与社会服务与缩小发展差距存在关联。

title: From catastrophe to culture: The role of historical disasters in shaping long-term orientation
title_zh: 从灾难到文化：历史灾难在塑造长期导向中的作用
title_primary: 从灾难到文化：历史灾难在塑造长期导向中的作用
title_secondary: From catastrophe to culture: The role of historical disasters in shaping long-term orientation
authors: Meng Liu, Jun Wang, James B. Ang, Per G. Fredriksson
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Natural disasters expose societies to an external environment that requires forward-looking adaptation. This paper argues that societies with greater historical exposure to natural disasters are more likely to develop long-term-oriented norms that emphasize preparation, saving, and future well-being. We test this hypothesis by linking historical exposure to earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic eruptions from 4360 BC to 1980 CE to contemporary long-term orientation. Disaster exposure is proxied by a distance-based measure that aggregates proximity to major catastrophic events over long horizons. Long-term orientation is examined using folklore traditions at the ethnic level and survey-based evidence at the individual and country levels. Across all levels of analysis, we find that greater cumulative disaster exposure is associated with significantly stronger long-term orientation. Evidence from folklore and second-generation migrants suggests that these effects operate through cultural adaptation and intergenerational transmission.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害使社会面临需要前瞻性适应的外部环境。本文认为，历史上遭受更多自然灾害的社会更可能形成强调准备、储蓄和未来福祉的长期导向规范。我们通过将公元前4360年至公元1980年间地震、海啸和火山喷发的历史暴露与现代长期导向相联系来检验这一假设。灾害暴露采用基于距离的度量指标，该指标汇总了长期内与重大灾难事件的邻近程度。长期导向则通过族群层面的民间传说传统以及个体和国家层面的调查证据进行考察。在所有分析层面上，我们发现累积灾害暴露程度越高，长期导向显著越强。来自民间传说和第二代移民的证据表明，这些效应通过文化适应和代际传递发挥作用。

title: Multiple Creditors and Information Rights: Theory and Evidence from US Firms
title_zh: 多个债权人及信息权：来自美国企业的理论与证据
title_primary: 多个债权人及信息权：来自美国企业的理论与证据
title_secondary: Multiple Creditors and Information Rights: Theory and Evidence from US Firms
authors: Luigi Guiso, Raoul Minetti
official: 官方在线 2004-03-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyse how a firm allocates information rights across its multiple banks. By differentiating information disclosed, a firm prevents its banks from continuing projects (possibly unsound) solely in order to use their superior information and seize assets during the reorganization. Informational diversity can also lead to the premature liquidation of sound projects, however. We derive the optimal allocation of information as a function of the redeployability and the heterogeneity of the firm?s assets, and of the costs of restructuring the firm in distress. Using a sample of US firms, we find evidence that supports the empirical predictions of the model.
abstract_zh: 本文分析企业如何在其多家银行之间分配信息权。通过区分所披露的信息，企业可防止其银行仅为了利用自身信息优势并在重组期间夺取资产而继续（可能不健全的）项目。然而，信息多样性也可能导致健全项目被过早清算。我们推导出信息的最优分配，该分配取决于企业资产的可重新部署性、异质性以及企业陷入困境时的重组成本。基于美国企业样本，我们发现了支持模型实证预测的证据。

title: Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
title_zh: 离婚后的生活：共同监护对父母及子女的影响
title_primary: 离婚后的生活：共同监护对父母及子女的影响
title_secondary: Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
authors: Stella Canessa, Gordon B. Dahl, Anna Hasselqvist, Costas Meghir, Susan Niknami 等
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Divorce reshapes family life, yet little is known about one of its most consequential features: the allocation of child custody. We study the impact of joint versus sole custody on both parents and children using rich administrative data from Sweden linked to over 25 years of newly-collected court custody rulings. To address selection concerns, we exploit random assignment of custody disputes to judges who differ sharply in their propensity to grant joint custody. For fathers, joint custody substantially raises earnings and improves mental health, consistent with sustained paternal involvement enhancing labor market attachment and psychological well-being. In contrast, there are no measurable labor market or mental health effects for mothers. Turning to children, joint custody increases standardized test scores and school quality without affecting mental health outcomes. Joint custody increases fathers’ chances of remarriage, keeps separated parents in closer geographic proximity, and has no effect on intimate partner violence allegations against either partner. These findings inform longstanding debates over the role of child custody in shaping post-divorce family life.
abstract_zh: 离婚重塑了家庭生活，然而其最具深远影响的特征之一——子女监护权的分配——却鲜为人知。我们利用瑞典超过25年新收集的法院监护权裁决行政数据，研究共同监护与单独监护对父母及子女的影响。为应对选择性问题，我们利用监护权争议案件随机分配给倾向授予共同监护权程度迥异的法官这一机制。对父亲而言，共同监护显著提高了其收入并改善了心理健康，这与持续的父亲参与增强劳动力市场依附及心理福祉的结论一致。相比之下，母亲在劳动力市场或心理健康方面未观察到可测量的影响。就子女而言，共同监护提高了标准化考试成绩和学校质量，但未影响心理健康结果。共同监护增加了父亲再婚的可能性，使分居父母保持更近的地理距离，且未对任何一方的亲密伴侣暴力指控产生影响。这些发现为关于监护权如何塑造离婚后家庭生活的长期争论提供了依据。

title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据
title_primary: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据
title_secondary: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
authors: Ivan Ledezma, Antonia López‐Villavicencio
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation. JEL Classification : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。 JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33

title: How Wealth Across the Income Distribution Responds to Uncertainty: Insights from the Distributional Financial Accounts
title_zh: 收入分配各阶层的财富如何应对不确定性：来自分配金融账户的启示
title_primary: 收入分配各阶层的财富如何应对不确定性：来自分配金融账户的启示
title_secondary: How Wealth Across the Income Distribution Responds to Uncertainty: Insights from the Distributional Financial Accounts
authors: Lilia Maliar, Christopher Naubert
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use the US Distributional Financial Accounts to assess how wealth across the income distribution responds to uncertainty shocks. Following an uncertainty shock, we find that wealth inequality between those in the top percentile of the income distribution and those in the bottom fortieth percentile of the income distribution declines. We show that the result is driven by systematic differences in portfolio composition between high income and low income individuals, with high income individuals having greater exposure to high risk assets. The response of high risk asset inequality is negative while the response of low risk asset inequality is positive. Therefore, the decline in wealth inequality is due to high income individuals losing more relative to lower income individuals rather than lower income individuals catching up to higher income individuals.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国分配金融账户数据，评估收入分布各阶层的财富如何响应不确定性冲击。研究发现，在不确定性冲击发生后，收入分布前百分位群体与后四十百分位群体之间的财富不平等程度有所下降。这一结果源于高收入与低收入群体在资产组合构成上的系统性差异——高收入群体对高风险资产的敞口更大。高风险资产不平等呈负向响应，而低风险资产不平等呈正向响应。因此，财富不平等的下降并非低收入群体追赶高收入群体所致，而是高收入群体相对损失更大。

title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果
title_primary: 碳定价的不平等经济后果
title_secondary: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
authors: Känzig, Diego R.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
abstract_zh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征与高频数据，我识别出碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击推高能源价格、减少排放、刺激绿色创新，但会抑制经济活动——且对贫困家庭造成不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受到更大影响，其收入损失也更为显著。这些通过收入与就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。

title: The Big Short (Interest): Closing the Loopholes in the Dividend-Withholding Tax
title_zh: 大空头（空头利息）：堵塞股息预扣税漏洞
title_primary: 大空头（空头利息）：堵塞股息预扣税漏洞
title_secondary: The Big Short (Interest): Closing the Loopholes in the Dividend-Withholding Tax
authors: Elisa Casi, Evelina Gavrilova, David Murphy, Floris T. Zoutman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of stricter enforcement of the dividend-withholding tax (DWT). We focus on a 2016 Danish enforcement reform and compare Denmark to its Nordic neighbors. Throughout the Nordic stock markets, shares on loan spike sharply around dividend dates. These spikes are consistent with abuse of the DWT system. Postreform, spikes in Denmark disappear, and annual DWT revenue increases by 130 percent. Enforcement does not harm the investment climate as measured by Danish stock returns, investment rate, and dividend yield. (JEL G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了股息预扣税（DWT）执行力度加强的影响。重点关注2016年丹麦的一项执法改革，并将丹麦与其北欧邻国进行比较。在整个北欧股票市场中，股票借贷量在股息发放日前后急剧飙升。这些飙升现象与DWT制度的滥用行为相符。改革后，丹麦的此类飙升现象消失，年度DWT收入增长130%。以丹麦股票回报率、投资率和股息收益率衡量，执法并未损害投资环境。（JEL分类号：G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34）

title: Long-Distance Trade and Long-Term Persistence
title_zh: 长途贸易与长期持续性
title_primary: 长途贸易与长期持续性
title_secondary: Long-Distance Trade and Long-Term Persistence
authors: Ellingsen, Sebastian
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do changes in the location of trading opportunities cause changes in the location of economic activity? I explore this question using a lifting of restrictions on trade across the Spanish Empire in the 18th century. I combine a difference-in-differences approach with a dynamic spatial model to examine this issue. I find that the reform improved market integration and induced urban growth, but had a smaller effect in locations with larger internal markets. The findings suggest that the location of economic activity adapts to changes in the location of trading opportunities, but persists when these changes are preceded by urban growth.
abstract_zh: 贸易机会地点的变化是否会导致经济活动地点的变化？我利用18世纪西班牙帝国贸易限制的解除来探究这一问题。我将双重差分法与动态空间模型相结合进行分析。研究发现，改革改善了市场一体化并促进了城市增长，但在内部市场规模较大的地区影响较小。结果表明，经济活动地点会适应贸易机会地点的变化，但当这些变化发生在城市增长之后时，则表现出持续性。

title: Immigration Enforcement and Origin Country Labor Markets
title_zh: 移民执法与来源国劳动力市场
title_primary: 移民执法与来源国劳动力市场
title_secondary: Immigration Enforcement and Origin Country Labor Markets
authors: Thomas Pearson, Michael Topper, Toshio Ferrazares, Lester Lusher, Tim Ruberg 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how increased immigration enforcement in the destination country impacts labor markets in the origin country. Using variation in Mexican migrant networks and Secure Communities (SC), a policy which expanded local immigration enforcement, I show that the deportation of Mexican migrants from the U.S. increases return migration to Mexico and decreases monthly earnings for workers there. The negative earnings effects are largest for workers most similar to return migrants in terms of their demographics, occupations, and employment types, and are consistent with increased labor market competition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了目的地国家加强移民执法如何影响来源国的劳动力市场。利用墨西哥移民网络及“安全社区”（Secure Communities, SC）政策——该政策扩大了地方移民执法范围——的变异，我证明美国对墨西哥移民的驱逐增加了返回墨西哥的移民数量，并降低了当地工人的月收入。负面收入效应在那些与返回移民在人口特征、职业及就业类型上最为相似的工人中最为显著，这与劳动力市场竞争加剧的解释相一致。

title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
title_zh: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计
title_primary: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计
title_secondary: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
authors: Margherita Comola, Amit Dekel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文探讨了不完全信息链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。我们将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅部分可观测的博弈场景。我们提出了所设计的两步估计量的计量经济学特征，并通过模拟实验验证其性能。将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄风险分担安排的数据后，结果表明间接连接具有显著影响。

title: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
title_zh: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异
title_primary: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异
title_secondary: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
authors: Nicola Amendola, Luis Araujo, Leo Ferraris
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.
abstract_zh: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个本质差异：与实物货币不同，数字货币使货币当局能够追踪账户中的资金流入与流出。我们证明，货币当局可利用这一记账技术的进步，在广泛情境下改进实物货币并实现效率提升。

title: Protectionism and Platform Revenues
title_zh: 保护主义与平台收入
title_primary: 保护主义与平台收入
title_secondary: Protectionism and Platform Revenues
authors: Massimo Morelli, Gianmarco Ottaviano, Tommaso Sonno
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The Arab Spring made evident the dangers of democratization of information for incumbent governments, prompting regulatory changes that helped digital platforms gain power. We document a set of political favors (tariff sparing) for US tech manufacturing in 2018, but the rise of platform revenues does not depend on such favors: digital platforms may benefit from tariffs even when they are not protected and their customers are not protected. In an open economy with ad valorem commissions on the tariff-inclusive consumer price, platform revenue rises with the tariff if and only if demand elasticity is below one in absolute value.
abstract_zh: 阿拉伯之春揭示了信息民主化对现任政府构成的危险，促使监管变革助力数字平台获取权力。我们记录了2018年美国科技制造业获得的一系列政治优惠（关税减免），但平台收入的增长并不依赖于此类优惠：即便数字平台未受保护且其客户也未受保护，它们仍可能从关税中获益。在开放经济中，若按含关税的消费者价格收取从价佣金，则平台收入随关税上升而增加当且仅当需求弹性绝对值小于1。

title: Trade, innovation, and natural capital: Growth dynamics near ecological thresholds
title_zh: 贸易、创新与自然资本：生态阈值附近的增长动态
title_primary: 贸易、创新与自然资本：生态阈值附近的增长动态
title_secondary: Trade, innovation, and natural capital: Growth dynamics near ecological thresholds
authors: Nicoletta Batini, Luigi Durand
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how increased trade in renewable nature-based inputs — such as wild terrestrial and marine biomass, along with tradable forms of clean air, soil, and water — affects economic growth in a world constrained by finite natural capital. Using a standard two-region endogenous growth model, we introduce two novel features: (i) a framework that explicitly models nature-based inputs by accounting for both the stock of natural capital and the flow of ecosystem services it generates, and (ii) ecological tipping points—thresholds beyond which natural capital and the ecosystems that sustain it may undergo irreversible degradation. We find that while global integration benefits all regions in the long run, it slows growth in nature-rich countries during the transition due to over-specialization and increased dependence on foreign technology. However, when tipping points are considered, agents internalize the risk of ecological collapse, reduce resource extraction, and shift toward innovation. Coordinated innovation and conservation policies can support more balanced and sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在受有限自然资本约束的世界中，可交易的可再生自然基础投入品——如野生陆地和海洋生物质，以及可交易形式的清洁空气、土壤和水——贸易增加如何影响经济增长。通过使用标准的双区域内生增长模型，我们引入了两个新特征：（i）一个明确建模自然基础投入品的框架，同时考虑自然资本存量及其产生的生态系统服务流量；（ii）生态临界点——超过这些阈值，自然资本及其维持的生态系统可能遭受不可逆转的退化。我们发现，尽管全球一体化长期内惠及所有区域，但在转型期间，由于过度专业化和对外国技术的依赖增加，它减缓了自然丰富国家的增长。然而，当考虑临界点时，行为主体会内化生态崩溃的风险，减少资源开采，并转向创新。协调一致的创新与保护政策可以支持更加平衡和可持续的发展。

title: When do proxy advisors improve corporate decisions?
title_zh: 代理顾问何时改善公司决策？
title_primary: 代理顾问何时改善公司决策？
title_secondary: When do proxy advisors improve corporate decisions?
authors: Berno Buechel, Lydia Mechtenberg, Alexander F. Wagner
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the impact of proxy advisors on shareholder decision‐making. We posit two assumptions: (i) the board is at least as well informed as any individual shareholder; (ii) shareholders can condition their information acquisition on the proxy advisor's (PA) recommendation. If only (i) holds, shareholders optimally rubber‐stamp the board's proposal and do not invest in private research. If (ii) additionally holds, disagreement between the board and the PA can trigger private information acquisition by some shareholders. We identify the conditions under which this mechanism restores value‐of‐information logic and improves the informational quality of shareholder voting outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究代理顾问对股东决策的影响。我们提出两个假设：（i）董事会至少与任何单个股东拥有同等信息；（ii）股东可根据代理顾问（PA）的建议调整其信息获取行为。若仅满足假设（i），股东最优策略是盲目批准董事会提案，且不投入私人研究。若同时满足假设（ii），董事会与代理顾问之间的分歧可能触发部分股东获取私人信息。我们识别了该机制恢复信息价值逻辑并提升股东投票结果信息质量的条件。

title: Market expansion and litigation deterrence effects of patents: Evidence from Chinese exporters
title_zh: 专利的市场扩张与诉讼威慑效应：来自中国出口企业的证据
title_primary: 专利的市场扩张与诉讼威慑效应：来自中国出口企业的证据
title_secondary: Market expansion and litigation deterrence effects of patents: Evidence from Chinese exporters
authors: Xinghua Deng, Ran Jing, John Ries
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract China's overseas patents grew rapidly in the past two decades at the same time as China became the world's largest exporter of merchandise goods. This paper investigates the effects of overseas patents on the volume and prices of Chinese firms' exports. We consider two channels. First, patents prevent imitation and rival entry, leading to higher quantities and prices. Second, patents reduce the likelihood of litigation and can allow firms to price more aggressively if they are keeping prices high to deter potential litigation in the export market. We find evidence of both. Both channels predict a higher quantity of exports, and we find evidence of that in the data. We also compile evidence consistent with patents allowing Chinese firms to price more aggressively (lower prices).
abstract_zh: 摘要 过去二十年，中国海外专利数量快速增长，与此同时，中国成为全球最大的商品出口国。本文研究海外专利对中国企业出口规模与价格的影响。我们考虑两种作用机制：其一，专利阻止模仿与竞争者进入，从而提升出口数量与价格；其二，专利降低诉讼风险，若企业为规避出口市场潜在诉讼而维持高价，则专利可使其采取更激进的定价策略。实证结果支持两种机制的存在。两种机制均预测出口数量增加，数据验证了这一结论。此外，我们发现的证据表明，专利使中国企业能够采取更激进的定价策略（即降低价格）。

title: Fiscal policy divergence
title_zh: 财政政策分化
title_primary: 财政政策分化
title_secondary: Fiscal policy divergence
authors: Piera Bello, Sergio Galletta, Costanza Marconi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a novel measure of fiscal policy divergence based on public budget data. First, we quantify policy similarity across municipalities based on the cosine similarity of their budget allocations, showing strong correlations with geographic proximity and differences in socio-demographic characteristics. Next, we predict budget similarity out-of-sample using a flexible machine-learning model trained on pairwise differences in local characteristics, defining fiscal divergence as the municipality-year average absolute prediction error. In an empirical application to 8000 Italian municipalities (2000–2015), we show that electoral-cycle patterns are concentrated on the expenditure side of the budget: expenditure divergence is lower in pre-electoral years than in election years, whereas revenue divergence follows a different and less stable pattern.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文基于公共预算数据提出了一种衡量财政政策差异的新方法。首先，我们利用预算分配的余弦相似度量化各市镇间的政策相似性，发现其与地理邻近性及社会人口特征差异存在强相关性。其次，我们采用灵活的机器学习模型，基于地方特征的两两差异对预算相似性进行样本外预测，并将财政差异定义为市镇-年份层面平均绝对预测误差。在对意大利8000个市镇（2000-2015年）的实证分析中，我们发现选举周期模式集中于预算支出端：选举前年份的支出差异低于选举年份，而收入差异则呈现不同且较不稳定的模式。

title: A Meta-analysis to Uncover the Effects of Drinking Water Pollution on Home Values
title_zh: 饮用水污染对房产价值影响的元分析
title_primary: 饮用水污染对房产价值影响的元分析
title_secondary: A Meta-analysis to Uncover the Effects of Drinking Water Pollution on Home Values
authors: Dennis Guignet, Anna Silva
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of hedonic studies examining the effects of potable water contamination on home values. We assess the robustness of the results to alternative weights, test for publication bias, and estimate meta-regressions to assess price effect heterogeneity. We find that the adverse effects on home values are similar across public versus private water sources, and that declines in home values persist for more than 10 years, on average. When contamination is detected the average decrease in home values is about 4-5%; and this effect increases to a 12-13% depreciation when contamination levels exceed regulatory or health-based standards. Key Words: benefit transfer, drinking water, groundwater, hedonic, housing value, property value, meta-analysis
abstract_zh: 我们对享乐主义研究中关于饮用水污染对房屋价值影响的相关文献进行了元分析。我们评估了不同权重下结果的稳健性，检验了发表偏倚，并通过元回归分析估计了价格效应的异质性。研究发现，公共水源与私人水源对房屋价值的负面影响相似，且房屋价值平均持续下降超过10年。当污染被检测到时，房屋价值平均下降约4-5%；而当污染水平超过监管或健康标准时，这一影响加剧至12-13%的贬值。关键词：效益转移、饮用水、地下水、享乐主义、住房价值、房产价值、元分析

title: Competition Policy and Agribusiness in the Biden Administration
title_zh: 拜登政府时期的竞争政策与农业综合企业
title_primary: 拜登政府时期的竞争政策与农业综合企业
title_secondary: Competition Policy and Agribusiness in the Biden Administration
authors: James M. MacDonald
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Biden Administration pursued a set of ambitious competition policy initiatives in agriculture and agribusiness, primarily aimed at livestock and poultry supply chains, farm inputs, and food retailing. The initiatives included expanded antitrust enforcement; new US Department of Agriculture (USDA) contract regulations requiring poultry processors to disclose more information to growers; and USDA financial support for expanded capacity in meat processing. I summarize the initiatives, evaluate what we know about their likely impacts, and discuss open research and policy issues.
abstract_zh: 拜登政府推行了一系列雄心勃勃的农业及农业综合企业竞争政策举措，主要针对畜牧和家禽供应链、农业投入品及食品零售领域。这些举措包括加强反垄断执法；美国农业部（USDA）出台新合同规定，要求家禽加工商向养殖户披露更多信息；以及USDA为扩大肉类加工产能提供财政支持。我概述了这些举措，评估了其可能影响的现有认知，并探讨了尚待解决的研究与政策问题。

title: Policy incentives for sustainable land use practices: Evidence from farmers’ choice behavior in dryland farming systems
title_zh: 可持续土地利用实践的政策激励：来自旱作农业系统农户选择行为的证据
title_primary: 可持续土地利用实践的政策激励：来自旱作农业系统农户选择行为的证据
title_secondary: Policy incentives for sustainable land use practices: Evidence from farmers’ choice behavior in dryland farming systems
authors: Seifu Gebrehiwet, Tewodros Tadesse, Girmay Tesfay, Tafesse W. Gezahegn
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Farming systems in many developing countries face persistent sustainability challenges, partly due to weak incentives for the adoption of ecologically sound practices. Existing policy instruments often reinforce this imbalance by favoring input-intensive approaches, such as chemical fertilizers, while neglecting sustainable soil management practices for which farmers often possess strong indigenous knowledge. Promoting sustainable agriculture in dryland farming systems therefore requires a better understanding of farmers’ preferences as well as the policy incentives that shape adoption decisions. This study examines how alternative policy incentives influence farmers’ choices regarding ecologically sustainable land management practices. Using a choice experiment with a between-subjects design, we elicited farmers’ trade-offs among different soil fertility and moisture-conserving practices under varying policy incentive schemes. For exploring preferences and estimating willingness to accept, we used mixed logit model. Results show negative preferences for chemical-based fertilization and positive preferences for moisture-conserving practices such as tie-ridges and trenches, which are well suited to dryland conditions. Preferences for zero tillage, although heterogeneous, are on average positive despite the widespread use of repeated tillage in current farming systems. Policy treatments reveal that cash transfers provide the strongest incentives for adopting sustainable practices, followed by input subsidies, whereas insurance mechanisms have weaker effects. These findings suggest that liquidity constraints constitute a major barrier to the uptake of sustainable land management. Policy interventions should thus prioritize flexible financial support instruments that allow farmers to allocate resources according to their specific production constraints, while complementing these with targeted incentives for practices that generate long-term environmental benefits. Adaptive policy designs that combine cash-based support, selective subsidies, and locally appropriate extension services are more likely to facilitate transitions toward sustainable agricultural systems.
abstract_zh: 许多发展中国家的农业系统面临持续性的可持续性挑战，部分原因在于采用生态友好型实践的激励不足。现有政策工具往往通过偏向于化肥等投入密集型方法，而忽视农民通常拥有丰富本土知识的可持续土壤管理实践，从而加剧了这一不平衡。因此，促进旱作农业系统中的可持续农业，需要更好地理解农民的偏好以及影响采纳决策的政策激励。本研究探讨了不同的政策激励如何影响农民对生态可持续土地管理实践的选择。采用受试者间设计的选择实验，我们获取了农民在不同政策激励方案下对多种土壤肥力及保水实践之间的权衡。为探究偏好并估算接受意愿，我们使用了混合Logit模型。结果显示，农民对化学基施肥表现出负面偏好，而对适应当地旱地条件的保水实践如垄沟和沟渠则表现出正面偏好。尽管存在异质性，但平均而言，农民对免耕的偏好为正，尽管当前农业系统中普遍采用重复耕作。政策处理显示，现金转移为采纳可持续实践提供了最强激励，其次是投入补贴，而保险机制的效果较弱。这些发现表明，流动性约束是采纳可持续土地管理的主要障碍。因此，政策干预应优先考虑灵活的财政支持工具，使农民能够根据其具体生产约束分配资源，并辅以针对产生长期环境效益的实践的有针对性激励。结合现金支持、选择性补贴和本地适宜的推广服务的适应性政策设计，更有可能促进向可持续农业系统的转型。

title: A model of participatory persuasion
title_zh: 参与式说服模型
title_primary: 参与式说服模型
title_secondary: A model of participatory persuasion
authors: Liuchun Deng, Yufeng Sun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of participatory persuasion in autocracies, where regimes use controlled communication to sustain their rule. In an overlapping-generations model of democratization, we show that the regime’s survival can be prolonged when citizens communicate within small circles compared to a setting in which communication is entirely absent. Paradoxically, limited freedom of speech enhances the regime’s persuasion by turning citizens into inadvertent agents of state propaganda. We further extend the analysis to settings with homophily or under state censorship.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了威权政体中“参与式说服”的概念，即政权通过受控沟通来维持其统治。在一个代际交叠的民主化模型中，我们证明，与完全没有沟通的环境相比，当公民在小圈子内交流时，政权的存续时间可以得到延长。矛盾的是，有限的言论自由通过将公民转变为国家宣传的无意代理人，增强了政权的说服力。我们进一步将分析扩展到同质性或国家审查制度下的情境。

title: Interaction of spectrum auctions and mobile market competition: Review of theory and evidence from European 4G auctions
title_zh: 频谱拍卖与移动市场竞争的互动：理论与欧洲4G拍卖证据综述
title_primary: 频谱拍卖与移动市场竞争的互动：理论与欧洲4G拍卖证据综述
title_secondary: Interaction of spectrum auctions and mobile market competition: Review of theory and evidence from European 4G auctions
authors: Daniel Ershov, David Salant
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effects of ex ante market structure on spectrum auctions and their impact on mobile market outcomes. We review the relevant theory and provide a simple analytic framework suggesting that larger incumbents acquire more spectrum in auctions to disadvantage smaller competitors. Using novel data on European 4G spectrum auctions, we present suggestive evidence of this effect for low-band ( < 1GHz) auctions. Exploiting idiosyncratic differences in auction timing across countries, we show that HHIs, and potentially prices, increase following low-band auctions, particularly in markets where incumbent operators had relatively high pre-auction market shares. These changes are not accompanied by improvements in coverage or increased investment. Operator-level regressions show that these effects are driven by incumbent operator behaviour.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了事前市场结构对频谱拍卖的影响及其对移动市场结果的作用。我们回顾了相关理论，并提供了一个简洁的分析框架，表明规模较大的在位运营商在拍卖中获取更多频谱，以削弱较小竞争对手的地位。利用欧洲4G频谱拍卖的新数据，我们为低频段（<1GHz）拍卖中的这一效应提供了提示性证据。利用各国拍卖时间上的特有差异，我们显示，在低频段拍卖后，赫芬达尔指数（HHIs）以及潜在的价格会上升，尤其是在拍卖前在位运营商市场份额相对较高的市场中。这些变化并未伴随覆盖范围的改善或投资的增加。运营商层面的回归分析表明，这些效应主要由在位运营商的行为驱动。

title: Public high school expansion and income inequality: Revisiting the race between education and technology
title_zh: 公立高中扩张与收入不平等：重访教育与技术的赛跑
title_primary: 公立高中扩张与收入不平等：重访教育与技术的赛跑
title_secondary: Public high school expansion and income inequality: Revisiting the race between education and technology
authors: Jakob Madsen, Holger Strulik
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the drivers of income inequality during the expansion of secondary education. We build a general equilibrium model with endogenous demand and supply of high school graduates and show that skill-biased technological change alone cannot explain the rise in educational attainment alongside the decline in the skill premium during the American high school movement. Instead, increased public spending on secondary education is key. Calibrating the model to U.S. data from 1830 to 1980, we assess the joint effects of technological change and education policy on long-run inequality. Through counterfactual historical analysis, we demonstrate that the expansion of public secondary education played a pivotal role in reducing income disparities during the 20th century. Panel regression for the 49 states give further evidence for the public spending channel.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中等教育扩张期间收入不平等的影响因素。我们构建了一个包含高中毕业生内生供需的一般均衡模型，并证明仅凭技能偏向型技术进步无法解释美国高中运动期间教育普及率上升与技能溢价下降并存的现象。相反，公共教育支出的增加是关键因素。通过将模型校准至1830年至1980年的美国数据，我们评估了技术进步与教育政策对长期不平等的联合效应。通过反事实历史分析，我们证明公共中等教育的扩展在20世纪减少收入差距方面发挥了关键作用。针对49个州的面板回归进一步为公共支出渠道提供了证据。

title: How to prevent joint information blocking: A study of blocking-proof diffusion auctions
title_zh: 如何防止联合信息封锁：防封锁扩散拍卖研究
title_primary: 如何防止联合信息封锁：防封锁扩散拍卖研究
title_secondary: How to prevent joint information blocking: A study of blocking-proof diffusion auctions
authors: Xindi Bai, Genjiu Xu, Wenzhong Li
official: 官方在线 2026-03-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Joint information blocking is the strategic behavior of a group of buyers that blocks competitors’ information. In the framework of diffusion auctions, joint information blocking employed by buyers’ tacit collusion can avoid competitive bidding, which leads to inefficiency of the auction mechanism. In this paper, blocking-proofness is introduced and investigated. Blocking-proofness means that buyers cannot benefit from joint information blocking, that is, from deleting diffusion relations to other buyers in the network. It is shown that blocking-proofness and incentive compatibility are independent, and both are necessary conditions for collusion-proofness. Finally, the blocking-proof diffusion auctions with monotonic allocation policies are fully characterized, and the independence of the conditions is discussed.
abstract_zh: 联合信息封锁是指一组买家采取的策略性行为，旨在阻碍竞争对手获取信息。在扩散拍卖框架下，买家通过默契合谋实施联合信息封锁，可规避竞争性报价，从而导致拍卖机制效率低下。本文引入并研究了防封锁性这一概念。防封锁性意味着买家无法通过联合信息封锁获益，即无法通过删除网络中与其他买家的扩散关系来获利。研究表明，防封锁性与激励相容性相互独立，且两者均为防合谋性的必要条件。最后，本文完整刻画了具有单调分配策略的防封锁扩散拍卖，并探讨了各条件的独立性。

title: Speculation in the United Kingdom, 1785‒2019
title_secondary: Speculation in the United Kingdom, 1785‒2019
authors: William Quinn, John D. Turner, Clive B. Walker
official: 官方在线 2026-01-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Speculation has long been thought to have significant economic effects, but it is difficult to measure, making it challenging to examine these effects empirically. In this paper we measure speculation in the United Kingdom since 1785 by using business and financial reporting in The Times newspaper. Our monthly speculation index reveals four distinct epochs of speculation in the United Kingdom. Epochs of high speculation coincide with higher stock market returns and higher economic growth, while low‐speculation periods coincide with high levels of government debt and financial repression. We find that low interest rates foment the development of higher speculation, and that eras of higher speculation are often followed by greater banking instability.
abstract_zh: 摘要长期以来，人们认为投机具有显著的经济效应，但其难以衡量，这给实证检验这些效应带来了挑战。本文通过利用《泰晤士报》中的商业与金融报道，测度了自1785年以来英国的投机活动。我们的月度投机指数揭示了英国投机的四个明显时期。高投机时期与较高的股市回报率和经济增长率相吻合，而低投机时期则与高水平的政府债务和金融抑制相伴。我们发现，低利率促进了更高水平投机的发展，而高投机时期之后往往伴随着更大的银行业不稳定性。

title: Postharvest losses from temperature during transit: Evidence from a million truckloads
title_zh: 运输途中温度导致的采后损失：基于百万车次数据的证据
title_primary: 运输途中温度导致的采后损失：基于百万车次数据的证据
title_secondary: Postharvest losses from temperature during transit: Evidence from a million truckloads
authors: Sarah C. Whitnall, Timothy K. M. Beatty
official: 官方在线 2025-10-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Around 13% of the global food supply is lost along production and supply chains including postharvest losses. We estimate the effect of weather and climate change on postharvest losses from data on 1.4 million truckloads of processing tomatoes in California. Our reduced-form estimation strategy compares processing tomatoes grown in the same field in the same season but experience different weather and traffic conditions during transit. Hot temperatures during transportation damage product quality, particularly when hot temperatures coincide with heavy traffic. When we compare best- and worst-case temperature and traffic conditions, the average rate of damage doubles but the economic effects are modest. We predict climate change will cause a negligible increase in postharvest losses by century's end. We add to prior work focused on farm output with little attention paid to effects of extreme weather and climate change on products after they leave the farm.
abstract_zh: 全球约13%的粮食供应在生产和供应链环节中遭受损失，其中包括采后损失。我们利用加州140万车次加工番茄的数据，估算了天气和气候变化对采后损失的影响。我们的简化形式估计策略比较了同一田地、同一季节种植但运输途中经历不同天气和交通条件的加工番茄。运输期间的高温会损害产品质量，尤其是当高温与交通拥堵同时发生时。在比较最佳和最差温度及交通条件时，平均损坏率翻倍，但经济影响相对有限。我们预测，到本世纪末，气候变化将导致采后损失增加微乎其微。我们的研究补充了以往侧重于农场产出的工作，而极少关注极端天气和气候变化对农产品离开农场后产品的影响。

title: Navigating the impact of ESG sustainability uncertainty on fossil fuel prices: evidence from wavelet cross-quantile regression
title_zh: ESG可持续性不确定性对化石燃料价格的影响：基于小波交叉分位数回归的证据
title_primary: ESG可持续性不确定性对化石燃料价格的影响：基于小波交叉分位数回归的证据
title_secondary: Navigating the impact of ESG sustainability uncertainty on fossil fuel prices: evidence from wavelet cross-quantile regression
authors: Victoria Olushola Olanrewaju Tomiwa Sunday Adebayo Berna Uzun a Advanced Research Centre, European University of Lefke, Lefke, Northern Cyprus, Turkeyb Operational Research Center in Healthcare, Near East University 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Amidst a rapidly evolving energy landscape, understanding how ESG-driven sustainability risks reshape oil, heating oil, and natural gas prices is crucial for investors and policymakers charting a resilient path forward. Therefore, this study utilizes the recently developed ESG-based sustainability uncertainty index (ESGUI), which provides a crucial tool for assessing how ESG (environmental, social, governance) uncertainties are integrated into investment decisions. This research examines the impact of ESGUI on fossil fuel energy price volatility, using data from 2002:M11 to 2024:M9. Additionally, the study introduces wavelet cross-quantile regression to capture this relationship. The results show that ESGUI has a predominantly negative short-term impact on oil, heating oil, and natural gas prices, especially under bearish or moderately active market conditions. However, in the long term, ESG uncertainty tends to increase prices across all three fuels – reflecting market adjustments to regulatory risks, supply concerns, and hedging strategies. Based on these findings, the study formulates relevant policy recommendations.
abstract_zh: 在快速演变的能源格局中，理解ESG驱动的可持续性风险如何重塑石油、取暖油和天然气价格，对于投资者和政策制定者规划韧性发展路径至关重要。因此，本研究利用近期开发的基于ESG的可持续性不确定性指数（ESGUI），该指数为评估ESG（环境、社会、治理）不确定性如何融入投资决策提供了关键工具。本研究考察了ESGUI对化石燃料能源价格波动的影响，使用了2002年11月至2024年9月的数据。此外，研究引入了小波分位数回归来捕捉这一关系。结果显示，ESGUI对石油、取暖油和天然气价格主要产生短期负面影响，尤其是在市场看跌或适度活跃的条件下。然而，长期来看，ESG不确定性倾向于推高所有三种燃料的价格——反映了市场对监管风险、供应担忧及对冲策略的调整。基于这些发现，研究提出了相关政策建议。

title: Including Harvested Grain Biogenic CO2 to Address a Critical Flaw in Climate Accounting
title_zh: 将收获谷物生物源CO2纳入核算以解决气候核算中的关键缺陷
title_primary: 将收获谷物生物源CO2纳入核算以解决气候核算中的关键缺陷
title_secondary: Including Harvested Grain Biogenic CO2 to Address a Critical Flaw in Climate Accounting
authors: Richard S. Gray
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The international climate accounting system excludes both the biogenic CO 2 sequestered in harvested crops and the biogenic CO 2 emissions that occur when grain is digested or burned as biofuel. Despite being described in the literature as a critical flaw in climate accounting all parties within the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change continue to treat these large biogenic CO 2 fluxes as carbon‐neutral activities, while analysis of the accounting issue remains largely absent from the extensive literature examining international carbon leakage and GHG mitigation policy. Using a partial‐equilibrium trade model, I analyse the economic implications of measuring harvested‐grain biogenic CO 2 and find in the presence of traded grain and internationally heterogeneous GHG mitigation policy, measurement would change optimal domestic agricultural GHG mitigation policy. Given estimated CO 2 damage costs of $185/t, the unmeasured external biogenic benefit from grain production, and the unmeasured external biogenic cost from grain consumption, are equal in magnitude to the price of grain. Including the biogenic harvested‐grain CO 2 in Canada's national inventory reduces measured emissions by 80 million tonnes per year. The size of these effects suggest that the measurement of harvested‐grain biogenic CO 2 could be extremely consequential for the design of optimal GHG mitigation policy. JEL Classifications : Q15, Q54
abstract_zh: 国际气候核算体系既未计入收获作物中封存的生物源二氧化碳，也未计入谷物消化或作为生物燃料燃烧时产生的生物源二氧化碳排放。尽管文献中将其描述为气候核算的一个关键缺陷，但《联合国气候变化框架公约》所有缔约方仍继续将这些大量的生物源二氧化碳通量视为碳中性和活动，而关于这一核算问题的分析在考察国际碳泄漏和温室气体减缓政策的广泛文献中基本缺失。利用部分均衡贸易模型，我分析了计量收获谷物生物源二氧化碳的经济影响，并发现，在谷物贸易存在且各国温室气体减缓政策存在国际差异的情况下，计量将改变最优的国内农业温室气体减缓政策。鉴于估算的二氧化碳损害成本为185美元/吨，谷物生产中未计量的外部生物源效益与谷物消费中未计量的外部生物源成本，其规模与谷物价格相当。将收获谷物生物源二氧化碳纳入加拿大国家清单，将使测得的排放量每年减少8000万吨。这些效应的规模表明，计量收获谷物生物源二氧化碳可能对最优温室气体减缓政策的设计产生极其重大的影响。JEL分类：Q15，Q54

title: Effects of Bank Capital Requirement Tightenings on Inequality
title_zh: 银行资本要求收紧对不平等的影响
title_primary: 银行资本要求收紧对不平等的影响
title_secondary: Effects of Bank Capital Requirement Tightenings on Inequality
authors: Sandra Eickmeier, Benedikt Kolb, Esteban Prieto
official: 官方在线 2023-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use a newly constructed narrative measure of regulatory bank capital requirement tightening events (Eickmeier et al., 2023) to examine their effects on household income and expenditure inequality in the US. Income and expenditure inequality both decline (the latter decline being slightly less pronounced than the former). Financial income strongly drops after the regulatory events. Richer households tend to be more exposed to financial markets. Hence, their income and expenditures decline by more than those of poorer households. The monetary policy easing after the regulation is shown to contribute to the decline in inequality at longer horizons, as it cushions the negative effects of the capital requirement tightenings on wages and salaries in the medium run, which represent a considerable share of income for lower- to middle-income households.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新构建的叙事性银行资本监管要求收紧事件指标（Eickmeier等，2023），研究其对美国居民家庭收入与支出不平等的影响。研究发现，收入不平等与支出不平等均有所下降（后者降幅略小于前者）。监管事件发生后，金融收入显著下降。富裕家庭通常更易受金融市场波动影响，因此其收入与支出的降幅大于贫困家庭。研究表明，监管实施后的宽松货币政策在长期内有助于降低不平等程度——该政策在中长期缓冲了资本要求收紧对工资薪金的负面冲击，而工资薪金在中低收入家庭收入中占据相当比重。
